about: The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com), a San Francisco local news site. This CLI searches articles and lists the latest, tag, section, topic-series and author stories with dates and URLs, and reads full articles.

commands.summary: Keyword search across all SF Standard articles (tech, housing, transit, city news). Returns headline, date and URL; sort by relevance or newest, filter by date range, section or author.

params.name: query
params.description: Search keywords, e.g. housing, Muni, AI

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort order: relevance (best match) or date (newest first)

params.name: dateRange
params.description: Date filter written as a JSON value. Use null for any time, or a quoted range code such as "1m" (past month). The UI also offers past 7 days and past year.

params.name: sectionId
params.description: Optional section filter: a quoted section UUID, e.g. "ffcbb756-8c8f-4da5-9c82-27d319cf6487" (News). Leave empty for all sections.

params.name: authorId
params.description: Optional author filter: a quoted author UUID (authors[].id in results). Leave empty for all authors.

commands.summary: Newest articles across the whole site (the Latest feed), newest first, with dates and URLs.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Number of articles to return (the site loads 10). clify's own --limit only shapes the output.

commands.summary: Latest articles for a topic tag such as tech, transportation, criminal-justice or housing, with dates and URLs.

params.name: slug
params.description: Tag slug from /tag/<slug>/, e.g. tech, transportation, criminal-justice

commands.summary: Full article by its URL parts (/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/): headline, description, publish date, authors, section, keywords and full body text.

params.name: slug
params.description: Article slug, the last segment of the article URL

commands.summary: Top and recent stories on a section front page such as news or business, with dates and URLs.
Articles in a topic series ("obsession") such as real-estate, boom-loop, crisis-in-streets, artificial-intelligence or school-wars.

params.name: slug
params.description: Series slug from /obsession/<slug>/, e.g. real-estate, boom-loop, artificial-intelligence

commands.summary: Recent articles by one reporter, looked up by author slug.
Comment status and counts for an article, looked up by its article id (the id field in search and list results).

params.name: storyId
params.description: Article UUID (id field from search or list results)
